comment: Registry of every error code that crosses the Tauri bridge, and the
cross-language contract that keeps the two halves in step.
Same role as rate-resolution-vectors.json: one file, asserted from
both languages, so drift is caught from whichever side moves first.
Rust half (present):
crates/claudepot-core/src/error_code.rs :: tests
- every core enum variant's code appears here
- every owner="core" entry is produced by some variant
- the params[] list equals params()'s object keys
src-tauri/src/dto_error.rs :: tests
- every owner="command" entry is a const in codes::ALL,
and every const in codes::ALL appears here
TS half (the follow-up phase, not yet written):
a Vitest test asserting every code here has an errors.* entry
in src/locales/en (and zh-CN, or an explicit allowlist). Until
it lands, an unknown code renders `message` — English, correct,
untranslated. Seed copy for those catalog entries lives in
dev-docs/i18n-error-codes-seed.md.
Fields:
code    - <module>.<variant_snake_case>, lowercase.
owner   - "core"    an error enum variant in claudepot-core.
"command" an ad-hoc failure raised at a Tauri command
site with no core enum behind it. These are
candidates for promotion into a core enum;
until then the const in dto_error.rs::codes
is the single spelling.
params  - the names params() carries. A translator interpolates
these; renaming one is a breaking change to every
catalog entry that uses it.
message - a sample of the English Display string, illustrative
only. The live value travels as ErrorDto.message and
is what renders when a code has no catalog entry.
Adding a variant: code() stops compiling first, then the sampler in
error_code.rs's tests, then these vectors. Follow the chain.

codes.message: HTTP request failed: error sending request
token expired and refresh failed: token endpoint rejected refresh_token with 401
authentication failed: api key rejected by /v1/models
old and new paths are the same
ambiguous: old path contains invalid UTF-8
a claude process is running in /Users/me/proj — use --force to proceed
store open failed: unable to open database file
bad uuid: invalid length: expected length 32 for simple format, found 3
clipboard: failed to write to the clipboard
